name: Kothalipi
description:
Kothalipi (কথালিপি, Bengali for "speech-writing") adds dictation to GNOME Shell using OpenAI’s Whisper speech recognition model. It records from your microphone, transcribes locally on your machine, and copies the text to your clipboard. It requires a companion D-Bus service, installed separately (see the instructions on GitHub).

This extension accesses the clipboard to copy transcribed text.

Kothalipi is a fork of Speech2Text by Kaveh Tehrani (https://github.com/kavehtehrani/speech2text-extension).
